loss_labels.false_breakout: breakout trade; an M15 close came back inside the range within 8 bars of entry
loss_labels.range_too_narrow: range width < 1.5 x ATR14 at entry, or spread > 20% of the stop distance
loss_labels.range_too_wide: range width > 5 x ATR14 at entry
loss_labels.impulse_not_strong_enough: impulse size below the 20th percentile of all traded impulses (in pre-impulse ATR)
loss_labels.impulse_exhausted: impulse took >= 24 bars (6 h) from origin to extreme, or efficiency ratio < 0.5
loss_labels.poor_vah_val_location: traded boundary more than 3 ATR from both the weekly VAH and VAL
loss_labels.middle_of_range_entry: fill between 35% and 65% of the range height
loss_labels.entry_too_late: ping-pong: fill > 35% of width from the boundary; breakout: close penetration > 1 ATR
loss_labels.breakout_without_continuation: breakout trade stopped with MFE between 0.25R and 1R
loss_labels.failed_pullback: pullback entry stopped with MFE < 0.25R (no continuation attempt)
loss_labels.trend_continuation_against: ping-pong trade against the impulse direction, stopped, and the exit bar closed beyond the range on the impulse side
loss_labels.news_driven: exit bar (or entry bar) inside the 08:30/10:00 ET or FOMC slot proxy, or a shock bar (range > 3 ATR) during the trade
loss_labels.high_volatility: ATR14 percentile over the trailing 60 days >= 0.90 at entry
loss_labels.low_volatility: ATR14 percentile over the trailing 60 days <= 0.10 at entry
loss_labels.bad_orderflow_proxy: PROXY ONLY: signal-bar Dukascopy volume < 0.7 x 20-bar average (no footprint data exists)
loss_labels.multiple_failed_tests: traded boundary already touched >= 3 times (ping-pong) or a breakout already failed on this range
loss_labels.range_invalidated_before_entry: stopped within one M15 bar of the fill and that bar closed outside the range
loss_labels.stop_too_tight: a stop twice as far would have reached the original target; stop < 1 ATR
loss_labels.stop_too_wide: stop distance > 2.5 ATR or > 75% of the range height

filters.poor_symmetry: |drift| over the confirmation window > 30% of width
filters.middle_of_range: fill between 35% and 65% of the range
filters.va_too_far: boundary > 3 ATR from both weekly VAH and VAL
filters.va_inside_range: weekly VAH and VAL both inside the range
filters.too_many_tests: traded side already touched >= 3 times / breakout already failed
filters.breakout_extended: breakout close > 1 ATR beyond the boundary
filters.news_slot: signal inside the 08:30 / 10:00 ET / FOMC slot proxy
filters.low_liquidity: off-hours session or signal-bar volume < 50% of the 20-bar average
filters.unclear_boundary: fewer than 2 touches of the traded boundary before the signal
